
### Ruff and Knip

`ruff-0.14.3-fail.json` is a representative lint diagnostic matching
[Ruff 0.14.3's JSON snapshot](https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/blob/0.14.3/crates/ruff/tests/cli/snapshots/cli__lint__output_format_json.snap).
`knip-6.35.1-fail.json` is a representative report matching the installed
Knip 6.35.1 `dist/reporters/json.js` and `dist/reporters/util/util.js`.
It covers unused files, exports, and duplicate symbol groups.
